summary: Verified deployment-readiness fixes. BACKEND: 11/11 tests pass. Both health probes work — GET /health returns {ok:true, service:'bb-fm-kigali', db:'ok'} (200), GET /api/health returns {ok:true, service:'bb-fm-kigali', db:'ok', stripe:true, sms_providers:['route_mobile','whatsapp']} (200). JWT_SECRET change did NOT break auth: OTP start returns testCode, OTP verify returns accessToken with 'eyJ' prefix, and using that token against GET /api/admin/users returns 200 — proves JWT signed with new env-loaded secret validates correctly. All previously-working endpoints still work: GET /api/shows (200), GET /api/categories (200), GET /api/admin/sms/providers (200 with whatsapp.configured:true), GET /api/admin/payments/summary?days=30 (200), POST /api/billing/momo/initiate returns 400 with 'collection account' safety-guard message as expected, POST /api/billing/stripe/create-checkout returns 200 with cs_live_ sessionId. The guest profile card layout regression reported in iter 15 is now VISUALLY FIXED (icon → title → subtext → full-width button stacked vertically). No RN red-screen, no deprecated-package usage introduced by these fixes. All 3 deployment-readiness fixes (.gitignore, backend JWT/env/health, frontend .env quoting) verified non-breaking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py JWT_SECRET fallback: `os.environ.get('JWT_SECRET') or os.environ.get('SECRET_KEY')` with ephemeral-secret WARN fallback is a reasonable pattern for dev safety, but confirm the WARN branch never fires in prod (backend/.env now includes JWT_SECRET — verified present).

Root-level GET /health at app scope (bypassing /api prefix) is correct for K8s readiness probes since ingress only routes /api/* to backend. The dual-probe design (/health for K8s, /api/health for internal monitoring with richer payload) is sound.
frontend/.env: METRO_CACHE_ROOT is now properly quoted. All other keys use consistent quoting/no-comments convention required by preview env parser.
